mentions.name: Leadspilot
mentions.description: A lightweight CRM built with only HTML, JavaScript and PHP, designed for very fast loading and reliable performance on large page queries. It focuses on essential functionality such as search rather than piling on extra tools like email quotes, returning only the essential amount of data so the whole CRM runs smoothly. A demo is available at https://leadspilot.com.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a CRM built with only HTML, Javascript and PHP. Very fast loading and should hold up well on large page queries. The keyy is adding functionality that matters like, search by..., etc but not over doing the "tools" like email quotes etc. so they only give the essential amount of returned data so the whole CRM runs smooth.
